function fragmentCase() {
 const d=document.createElement('div'),checks={};
 d.innerHTML='<p>a</p>tail<!--comment-->';
 checks.nodes=d.childNodes.length===3 && d.textContent==='atail' && d.lastChild.nodeType===8;
 const old=d.firstChild;d.innerHTML='<u>fresh</u>';
 checks.detached=old.parentNode===null && old.textContent==='a' && d.textContent==='fresh';
 d.innerHTML='<table>before<tr><td>x</td></tr>after</table>';
 checks.foster=d.innerHTML==='beforeafter<table><tbody><tr><td>x</td></tr></tbody></table>';
 const text='a'.repeat(8188)+'😀&tail';d.innerHTML='<p>'+text.replace('&','&amp;')+'</p>';
 checks.unicode=d.firstChild.textContent===text && d.firstChild.childNodes.length===1;
 d.innerHTML='<svg><g id=svg></g></svg><math><mi>x</mi></math>';
 checks.namespaces=d.querySelector('#svg').namespaceURI==='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' && d.lastChild.namespaceURI==='http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML';
 d.innerHTML='<template><b>inert</b></template>';
 checks.template=d.querySelector('b')===null && d.firstChild.tagName==='TEMPLATE';
 d.innerHTML='';checks.empty=d.childNodes.length===0;
 const root=document.createElement('div').attachShadow({mode:'open'});root.innerHTML='<p>shadow</p>';
 checks.shadow=root.firstChild.textContent==='shadow' && root.firstChild.parentNode===root;
 return checks;
}
function arenaFactoryCase(mode) {
 const factories={element:()=>document.createElement('i'),namespace:()=>document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','g'),
 text:()=>document.createTextNode('x'),comment:()=>document.createComment('x'),fragment:()=>document.createDocumentFragment(),
 document:()=>document.implementation.createDocument(null,'root'),shadow:()=>document.createElement('div').attachShadow({mode:'open'}),
 textContent:()=>{document.body.textContent='x';}};
 let created=0,error;
 for(let i=0;i<100;i++){try{factories[mode]();created++;}catch(e){error=e;break;}}
 return created>0 && created<100 && error.message.includes('resource limit: DOM nodes');
}
